items.title: fix(mcp): preserve App pagination cursor bytes (#164368)
items.summary: fix(mcp): preserve App pagination cursor bytes (#164368) Fixes #164365. MCP Apps received the first or wrong tools or resource-template page when a server returned an empty or whitespace-bearing continuation cursor, because the UI bridge and the Gateway trimmed or dropped it. Present string cursors now pass through the bridge, the Gateway parser and MCP app operations unchanged. The wire shape (an optional string cursor) is unchanged, with no gateway-protocol schema change. Absent and normal cursors, resource aggregation and catalog discovery are unchanged. Proof: a built Gateway over authenticated WS, with a local stdio MCP App that paginates using `""` and padded cursors, dropped or trimmed them on base and returned the wrong page. With this change the exact bytes reached the server and the correct pages came back. The Gateway and installed AppBridge regression tests fail on base and pass here. A live gpt-5-mini smoke call passed. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: fix: Gateway stalls when background runs start outside the agent work…
items.summary: fix: Gateway stalls when background runs start outside the agent workspace (#164594) Runs whose workspace was not the agent's canonical workspace (cron jobs, subagents, and other runs without a canonical bootstrap workspace) keyed their own prepared runtime and cold-loaded the whole plugin inventory synchronously on the Gateway main thread. In a Gateway every run workspace resolves to the same immutable boot inventory, so that generation was a duplicate of the configured one. These runs now borrow the agent's configured generation and keep their own execution workspace, the same selection #164049 introduced for rooted runs; compaction follows it. Plugin tool resolution also cold-loaded, on every turn, selected tool plugins that the prepared generation had already recorded as disabled or failed (for example memory-core outside the selected memory slot). Those records are settled loader outcomes and are no longer reloaded. Measured with forced [trace:embedded-run] stage summaries in a Gateway-shaped fixture: prepared-runtime 10627 ms -> 0 ms, worst main-thread block 10610 ms -> 15 ms, per-turn tool cold loads 2 -> 0.

items.title: fix(doctor): quarantine an unusable agent deletion journal instead of…
items.summary: fix(doctor): quarantine an unusable agent deletion journal instead of blocking the update (#164509) A corrupted or unverifiable agent deletion journal made the candidate Doctor refuse the whole update as data-at-risk / incomplete-migration, blocking 2026.9.8 for an operator whose system agent carried a stale journal. Doctor now quarantines an unusable journal under the agent's recovery directory with a receipt, preserves the held stores and runtime deletion tombstones (never deletes), warns with the exact operator command, and lets the update continue; healthy agents stay eligible for migration and the reserved-agent-ID advice is corrected. Opportunistic bounded fix: detached automatic maintenance no longer relinquishes Doctor's database cleanup ownership (NOCOW lease release). Closes #164316. Reported on Discord (#general, Rlavington).
